hotel_name: Oyo Flagship 812491 Hotel Siddhartha Guest House

positive_snippets:
As a solo female traveler I found this place super safe moreover Staff are friendly and attentive - every request was carried out quickly and nothing seemed to be too much bother.
Rooms and whole atmosphere of the hotel is clean. Right place to stay under the budget

The owner of the hotel is highly professional and polite and he is never dependent on its staffs for any services that are required by the customers. Its a family hotel type OYO because he is maintaining the standard by applying decent price. Since morning I didnt see a single student coming in but 3-4 families are staying in rooms adjacent to my room.

Nice and decent place to stay near major markets like Gandhi Nagar, Krishna Nagar, Red Fort. Staff were very polite and respectful. As a female solo traveler the place felt very safe to spend the night. Would like to visit again whenever in Delhi.
